interactions.note: The epitope of nanobody 32 on vasopressin V2 receptor was determined from reconstruction of the subcomplex of ß-arrestin-V2T bound by nanobody 32 and Fab30 at 4.0 Å resolution. The subcomplex is part of a megaplex of the β2V2R–β-arr1 complex co-expressed with a prenylated GRK2 (GRK2-CAAX) bound to the high-affinity β2-adrenergic receptor (β2AR) agonist BI-167107 (BI) and stabilized by the conformationally sensitive antibody fragment Fab30. Gs protein was added to the β2V2R–β-arr1–Fab30 complex to form the megaplex along with nanobody 35 (Nb35) to stabilize the β2V2R–Gs interaction. The β2V2R is an N-terminal T4 lysozyme (T4L)-fused, modified β2AR with the first 341 residues of the β2AR combined with the last 29 amino acids of the V2R C-terminal tail (V2T0). Nanobody 32 (Nb32) was added to the megaplex to further stabilize active β-arr1 bound to the phosphorylated V2T.
